scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=packages/db && npm run build --workspace=packages/shared && npm run build --workspace=apps/web
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n db,shared,web,trigger -c gray,gray,blue,magenta "npm run dev --workspace=packages/db" "npm run dev --workspace=packages/shared" "npm run dev --workspace=apps/web" "npm run dev --workspace=apps/worker"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace=packages/db && npm run build --workspace=packages/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/web && npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/worker
